title: Odd sign tester
statement: Given a natural number $n$ and a real number $\delta\in[0,1]$, define a tester with seeds consisting of a sample from the correlated triple-cube distribution with parameter $\delta$ and an independent uniformly random Boolean sign choice for each of the three queries. The seed's Boolean choices specify the predicate-input negations, and its three queries are the corresponding sample query points, negated wherever the associated Boolean choice is true.
